title: Area Calculator
description: Calculate areas of circles, rectangles, and triangles with a flexible dispatcher function.

steps.title: Area of a circle
steps.description: Write an `areaOfCircle` function that calculates the area using the formula `π * r²`. Use `Math.PI` for pi.
hints: Area = Math.PI * r * r or Math.PI * r ** 2

verification.successMessage: Area of circle with radius 5 is about 78.54!

steps.title: Area of a rectangle
steps.description: Write an `areaOfRectangle` function that calculates the area using `width * height`.

steps.title: Area of a triangle
steps.description: Write an `areaOfTriangle` function that calculates the area using `base * height / 2`.

verification.successMessage: Area of triangle with base 10 and height 5 is 25!

steps.title: Calculate area by shape type
steps.description: Write a `calculateArea` function that takes a shape type string and the needed measurements, then calls the right function.
hints: Use a switch statement on the shape parameter
"circle": needs radius, "rectangle": needs width and height, "triangle": needs base and height

verification.successMessage: All three shape areas calculated through the dispatcher!

steps.title: Area summary for multiple shapes
steps.description: Write a function that takes an array of shape descriptions and prints an area summary for each.
hints: Each shape description is an object/array with type and measurements
Loop through and call calculateArea for each
Print a formatted line for each shape's area

verification.successMessage: Area summary for all shapes printed!
verification.failureMessage: Each shape should have a line with its type and calculated area.
